tasks.name: UX Flows and Screen Inventory
tasks.objective: Produce the UX Flows and Screen Inventory for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every screen listed with entry points, states and exit paths
HUD information hierarchy prioritised with a rationale
Input schemes for every declared platform described
Accessibility options enumerated with what they change

tasks.name: Interface Specification
tasks.objective: Produce the Interface Specification for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Components specified with sizes, spacing, states and text limits
Safe-area and resolution rules including mobile notches
Animation and transition timings in milliseconds

tasks.name: Interface Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Interface Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every screen reachable and operable on each declared platform
Text overflow, focus order and touch target sizes verified in the build
Contrast and readability checked against the art direction
